methodMaturity.reading: Two classifications exist and they can disagree. The DESCRIPTOR declares executorClass; `chooseExecutor` reads the METHOD STORE (routeId present in data/method/knowledge.json = GRADUATED). A model-class routeId the store has graduated would be dispatched DETERMINISTIC by chooseExecutor; a deterministic routeId the store has not learned would be dispatched to the bounded worker. The counts here are that disagreement, stated — not resolved.

cannotProgressWithoutNovelInvestigation.reading: model-class units whose open kind is NOT_MACHINE_EXECUTABLE: this process holds no client for the representation, so nothing deterministic can open it and only novel investigation (a Scout) can advance it.

scout.expectation: noMachineCapable = model-class units with NO Scout result in repos.scoutResults. BEFORE Scout activation the expectation is ALL of them; AFTER, fewer. A Scout result is the only machine-capable act recorded against a model-class unit.
